purpose: Port the raw-IMU stationary velocity and consecutive stationary Pose3 constraints present in the pinned upstream GNSS/IMU specification into the native GTSAM batch smartphone path. This is an opt-in research candidate; the Phase 12/16/19 lanes and production defaults remain unchanged.

selection_basis.current_gap: The native fixed-lag path has a separate opt-in ZUPT/NHC implementation, but the native smartphone batch path used by gnss_fgo_imu_no_base does not add the upstream stop velocity prior or the consecutive-stop Pose3 identity factor. The candidate therefore targets a specific backend gap rather than another carrier or smoothing heuristic.
alternatives_not_selected: absolute height constraints: the upstream absolute branch requires reference-height/ground-truth-like data unavailable under the raw-only contract
new carrier or ionosphere states: Phase 11-19 lanes already cover related raw candidates and are separately sealed
optimizer iteration retuning: previously audited independently and is not a new physical measurement component

forbidden_inputs: ground truth before the post-freeze score
raw_only_contract.stationarity_source: finite raw aligned IMU acceleration and gyro only
raw_only_contract.coordinate_source: native raw GNSS/nav FGO in memory

candidate_contract.acceleration_std_threshold: global finite minimum of sliding acceleration-norm std + 0.08 m/s^2
candidate_contract.gyro_std_threshold: global finite minimum of sliding gyro-norm std + 0.005 rad/s
candidate_contract.epoch_mapping: nearest aligned IMU stop flag, endpoint nearest hold (upstream interp1 nearest/extrap contract)
candidate_contract.application: velocity prior when stop(epoch) and initial GNSS/IMU velocity norm < 0.5 m/s; Pose3 identity between factor only when consecutive stop flags and preceding velocity gate pass

required: no new >70 m/s isolated continuity spike
nonzero stop diagnostics if raw stop flags exist
pre_score_structural_gate.comparison: same raw inputs and exact Phase 12 recipe with the candidate flag added; no score is used to select parameters

post_freeze_evaluation.truth_policy: after structural artifacts and hashes are sealed, read the declared development ground_truth.csv once in one process to compare frozen baseline and candidate
gates: all four official diagnostic variants non-regress

implementation_rule: Implement only this predeclared stop-constraint component and diagnostics after this record is committed to the working history; do not change Phase 19 outputs or tune any numeric value after truth access.
